verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs show several background automations: Dataform schedules complex transformation workflows, load jobs and data transfers can run at regular intervals, and continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously on incoming data. However, these are scheduled or streaming data pipelines, not AI-driven agentic automations. Dataform is also a companion service rather than core BigQuery. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-driven autonomous background tasks, detailed docs on setting up scheduled queries and triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
